purpose: Adjudication of the 12 roster records that do not correspond to one of the 753 gazetted local levels. Records are kept in roster.json and roster.csv.gz; this file marks which ones must be excluded from the coverage denominator and why. Attribution uses only active records.
source: Office of the Auditor General local-level report API (2026-11-05), cross-checked against the 753-unit structure and public records of local-level renames.

records.name: Kanda Rural Municipality
records.note: Kanda was granted separate rural-municipality status and then named Saipal. The gazetted name is Saipal; the roster carries both the interim and the final name.

records.name: Paandav Gufa Rural Municipality
records.note: Formed as Pandav Gufa and renamed Jagannath. The roster carries both names.

records.name: Lamidanda municipality
records.note: The gazetted unit is Rawa Besi, listed with Lamidanda as an alternate name. The roster carries both.

records.name: Parbatikunda Rural Municipality
records.note: Gazetted as Aamachhodingmo, listed with Parbatikunda as an alternate name.

records.name: Duikholi Rural Municipality
records.note: Renamed Pariwartan by the first village council.

records.name: Sukidaha Rural Municipality
records.note: Renamed Gangadev; the roster carries both.

records.name: Suwarnawati Rural Municipality
records.note: Renamed Sahid Sunil Smriti; the roster carries both.

records.name: Belhi chapena rural municipality
records.note: Gazetted as Rajgadh, listed with Belhi Chapena as an alternate name.

records.name: Dudhkaushika municipality
records.note: Dudhkaushika was renamed Thulung Dudhkoshi; the roster carries both.

records.name: Khijidemba rural municipality
records.note: Khijidemba is an Okhaldhunga local level. The Solukhumbu copy duplicates a unit that already exists in the roster under Okhaldhunga.

records.name: Sunkoshi rural municipality
records.note: The 2018 local-level code list names Udayapur's unit Sunkoshi; the gazetted name is Limchungbung. The roster carries both.

records.name: Nisdi Rural Municipality
records.note: Exact duplicate of record 488 (same district, same normalized name). The higher id is excluded.
